summary: FEMA major disaster declaration for Georgia (severe storm), declared 1995-12-20.

title: Trailers by Dorsey, Inc.: SUSPENSION:I-BEAM:SOLID:FRONT SPINDLE:KNUCKLE (50 affected)
summary: THESE AXLES CONSIST OF A STEEL TUBULAR CENTER SECTION AND FORGED STEEL SPINDLES THAT ARE WELDED TO EACH END OF THE TUBE. EITHER SPINDLE CAN CONTAIN A CIRCUMFERENTIAL CRACK THROUGH A PORTION OF ITS CROSS SECTION.

title: Ford Motor Company: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:RESTRAINT:BELT ANCHOR AND ATTACHM (229,500 affected)
summary: CRACKS HAVE BEEN FOUND IN THE FRONT SAFETY BELT OUTBOARD ANCHOR TABS DUE TO A COMBINATION OF HYDROGEN EMBRITTLEMENT OF THE TAB AND STRESS INTRODUCED DURING ATTACHMENT OF THE ANCHOR TAB TO THE SEAT FRAME. THIS DOES NOT CONFORM WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 210, "SEAT BELT ASSEMBLY ANCHORAGES."

title: General Motors, LLC: STRUCTURE:HOOD ASSEMBLY:HINGE AND ATTACHMENTS (12,783 affected)
summary: THESE VEHICLES COULD HAVE BEEN PRODUCED WITH AN IMPROPERLY ADJUSTED SECONDARY HOOD LATCH. THIS DOES NOT CONFORM TO THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 113, "HOOD LATCH SYSTEM."

title: Rolls-Royce Motor Cars, Ltd.: BRAKES:FLUID:HYDRAULIC (FLUID CONTAMINATION/WRONG (101 affected)
summary: AN INCOMPATIBILITY CAN EXIST BETWEEN THE MINERAL OIL SUPPLIED BY CASTROL AND THE HYDRAULIC BRAKE SYSTEM OF THESE VEHICLES.

title: Ford Motor Company: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:PIPE:FILLER:NECK (167,784 affected)
summary: THE FUEL TANK FILLER PIPE OPENING REINFORCEMENT, CONSTRUCTED FROM TWO SEPARATELY MOLDED PIECES, CAN LEAK AT THE WELD.

title: Ford Motor Company: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL (26,000 affected)
summary: DURING EXTREME COLD, NORTHERN CLIMATE WINTER CONDITIONS, ICE CAN FORM IN THE THROTTLE BODY OF THE ENGINE CAUSING THE THROTTLE PLATE TO REMAIN IN THE HIGHWAY CRUISING POSITION AFTER THE ACCELERATOR IS RELEASED OR THE SPEED CONTROL IS DEACTIVATED.

title: COSCO, INC.: EQUIPMENT:CHILD SEAT: INDEPENDENT (15,370 affected)
summary: THESE SEATS DO NOT MEET THE MAXIMUM BACK ANGLE REQUIREMENT OF FMVSS NO. 213, "CHILD RESTRAINT SYSTEMS."

title: Oshkosh Corporation: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY (876 affected)
summary: TWO TOP MOUNTING STRAPS SECURE THE FUEL TANK TO THE FRAME. BREAKAGE HAS OCCURRED WHERE THE STRAP BOLTS TO THE FRAME RAIL.

title: Volvo Trucks North America: SUSPENSION (120 affected)
summary: THE TILT CAB, WHEN RAISED TO ITS FULLEST UP POSITION, CAN CAUSE THE STEERING SHAFT TO BIND AGAINST THE STEERING GEAR.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): FUEL: VEHICLE CRASH, CUT OFF SYSTEM (5-94) (80,000 affected)
summary: THE FUEL TANK ROLLOVER VALVE CAN ALLOW FUEL TO PASS INTO THE VAPOR CANISTER RESULTING IN THE POTENTIAL FOR FUEL LEAKAGE.

title: CASTROL (U.K.) LTD.: BRAKES:FLUID:HYDRAULIC (FLUID CONTAMINATION/WRONG (600 affected)
summary: AN INCOMPATIBILITY CAN EXIST BETWEEN THE MINERAL OIL AND THE HYDRAULIC BRAKE SYSTEM OF THESE VEHICLES.

title: GRANNING AIR SUSPENSIONS: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:POWER ASSIST:CHECK VALVE (2,100 affected)
summary: INSIDE COMPONENTS OF THE VALVE FAIL TO WORK PROPERLY DUE TO INSUFFICIENT CLEARANCE BETWEEN THE ACTIVATION PIN AND BUSHING CAUSING THE VALVE TO SEIZE IN THE ACTIVATED POSITION.

title: BMW of North America, LLC: FUEL:FUEL LINES:HOSES:NON-METALLIC (18,000 affected)
summary: FUEL SEEPAGE CAN OCCUR BETWEEN A HOSE AND THE METAL FUEL LINE ON EITHER END OF THE HOSE RESULTING IN FUEL ODOR.

title: MOBILE-TECH CORPORATION: EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES (500 affected)
summary: WHEN POWER IS APPLIED INTERMITTENTLY TO THE RECEIVER PORTION OF THE REMOTE CONTROL, THE RECEIVER CAN LOCK UP IN AN UNKNOWN STATE WHICH MAY SEND A SIGNAL TO THE LIFT TO DEPLOY WITHOUT A COMMAND FROM THE DRIVER.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:ALTERNATOR:GENERATOR (12,000 affected)
summary: THE FASTENERS WHICH SECURE THE GENERATOR CARTRIDGE FUSE TO THE POWER DISTRIBUTION CENTER MAY HAVE AN IMPROPER CLAMP LOAD. IMPROPER CLAMPING CAN RESULT IN ARCING AT THE CONNECTION.

title: redundant NEW FLYER OF AMERICA, INC.: BRAKES:AIR SYSTEMS (373 affected)
summary: THE BRAKE RELEASE TIMING DOES NOT MEET THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 121, "AIR BRAKE SYSTEMS."

title: General Motors, LLC: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEAT BELTS:LAP:FRONT (630,099 affected)
summary: IF BOTH THE LAP-BELT AND SHOULDER-BELT ENERGY MANAGEMENT LOOPS ON THE FRONT SEAT BELT ASSEMBLIES RELEASE AT OR NEAR THE SAME TIME, ACCELERATION FORCES CAN CAUSE THE BUCKLE RELEASE MECHANISM TO ACTIVATE AND ALLOW THE BUCKLE TO SEPARATE FROM THE LATCH.

title: General Motors, LLC: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEAT BELTS:LAP:FRONT (40 affected)
summary: THESE VEHICLES WERE BUILT WITH FRONT SEAT BELT SYSTEMS WITH NO ENERGY MANAGEMENT LOOPS AND MAY NOT MEET THE HEAD INJURY CRITERIA REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 208, "OCCUPANT CRASH PROTECTION."

title: FLXIBLE CORPORATION: VISUAL SYSTEMS:WINDSHIELD WIPER AND WASHER (741 affected)
summary: THESE BUSES HAVE THE HEADLIGHTS AUTOMATICALLY ACTIVATED WHENEVER THE WINDSHIELD WIPERS ARE ACTIVATED. NO OTHER EXTERIOR LIGHTS ARE ACTIVATED BY WINDSHIELD WIPER ACTIVATION. THIS DOES NOT COMPLY WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 108, "LAMPS, REFLECTIVE DEVICES, AND ASSOCIATED EQUIPMENT."

title: COACHMEN INDUSTRIES, INC.: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:TRACKS AND ANCHORS:FRONT SEAT:POW (65 affected)
summary: THE WASHERS USED ON THE DRIVER'S SEATS WITH POWER SEAT ADJUSTMENTS WERE MISSING. ALSO, A SMALL NUMBER OF THE PEDESTALS MAY HAVE SMALL CRACKS IN THE JOINT BETWEEN THE BASE PLATE AND THE TUBE TO WHICH IT IS CONNECTED.

title: Nissan North America, Inc.: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:PIPE:FILLER:NECK (747,000 affected)
summary: IT IS POSSIBLE FOR A MIXTURE OF MUD AND SALT TO GET TRAPPED BETWEEN THE FUEL FILLER TUBE AND WHEEL HOUSING. THE TRAPPED MUD AND SALT CAN RESULT IN CORROSION OF THE FUEL FILLER TUBE AND THE WHEEL HOUSING.

title: Atwood Mobile Products: EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES:STOVE (126 affected)
summary: A 1/4" GAS LINE COMING OUT OF THE OUTLET SIDE OF THE OVEN THERMOSTAT MAY HAVE BEEN IMPROPERLY TIGHTENED.

title: Featherlite Trailer Manufacturing, LLC: STRUCTURE:FRAME:MEMBERS AND BODY (1,601 affected)
summary: IMPROPER WELD PROCEDURES WERE USED TO ATTACH THE TONGUE CHANNEL TO THE TRAILER FRAME.

title: Mazda North American Operations: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL (2,000 affected)
summary: DURING EXTREME COLD, NORTHERN CLIMATE WINTER CONDITIONS, ICE CAN FORM IN THE THROTTLE BODY OF THE ENGINE CAUSING THE THROTTLE PLATE TO REMAIN IN THE HIGHWAY CRUISING POSITION AFTER THE ACCELERATOR IS RELEASED OR THE SPEED CONTROL IS DEACTIVATED.

title: General Motors, LLC: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEATS (675,661 affected)
summary: THE SEAT RECLINER TO SEAT FRAME ATTACHING BOLTS ON THESE VEHICLE COULD LOOSEN, FATIGUE AND FRACTURE, ALLOWING THE SEAT BACK TO SUDDENLY RECLINE.

title: Utility Trailer Manufacturing Company: SUSPENSION:I-BEAM:SOLID:FRONT SPINDLE:KNUCKLE (5 affected)
summary: THESE AXLES CONSIST OF A STEEL TUBULAR CENTER SECTION AND FORGED STEEL SPINDLES THAT ARE WELDED TO EACH END OF THE TUBE. EITHER SPINDLE CAN CONTAIN A CIRCUMFERENTIAL CRACK THROUGH A PORTION OF ITS CROSS SECTION.

title: General Motors, LLC: FUEL:FUEL LINES:METALLIC (623 affected)
summary: CERTAIN TRUCKS HAVE FUEL RAIL ASSEMBLIES WITH AN IMPROPERLY CRIMPED END RETAINER CLIP THAT RESULTS IN A FUEL LEAK.

title: Porsche Cars North America, Inc.: EXHAUST SYSTEM:TAIL PIPE (91 affected)
summary: THE COVER SLEEVES ON THE EXHAUST TAILPIPES HAVE BEEN SECURED WITH ONLY TWO INSTEAD OF FOUR WELDING SPOTS.

title: Porsche Cars North America, Inc.: ENGINE COOLING SYSTEM (30 affected)
summary: THE INSIDE PIPES OF THE HEAT EXCHANGERS MIGHT BE SUBJECT TO CRACKING.
